THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

High-Protein Chipotle Cheddar Sauce

70 cal / 8g protein per 1/4 batch. Cottage cheese + cheddar powder + nutritional yeast, blended smooth. Adds Smoky Chipotle Crema for heat.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME5 min (blender only)
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~70 cal | ~8g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: 150 g 2% cottage cheese, not fat-free. The 2% version blends into a smoother, more cheese-like texture than fat-free.

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • 150 g 2% cottage cheese
  • 6 tbsp fat-free ultra-filtered milk
  • 1 tbsp cheddar cheese powder
  • 1 tbsp nutritional yeast
  • 2 tbsp Smoky Chipotle Crema (optional — for the adult / heat version)

Allergens: dairy. Packaged labels vary — verify current cottage cheese, ultra filtered milk, and cheddar powder labels before publishing allergen claims.

You want a high-protein cheese sauce that actually pours and tastes like cheddar. Cottage cheese carries body + protein; cheddar powder and nutritional yeast do the flavor. Smoky Chipotle Crema turns it into the adult version — omit it for the mild base.

Method

  1. 1.LOAD THE BLENDER. Cottage cheese + nutritional yeast + cheddar powder + ultra-filtered milk into a small blender or food processor.
  2. 2.ADD THE MILK. 6 tbsp fat-free ultra-filtered milk. Fairlife is shown; any fat-free ultra-filtered milk works.
  3. 3.ADD CHEDDAR POWDER + NUTRITIONAL YEAST. 1 tbsp each. Both carry the cheese flavor — nutritional yeast adds savory depth, cheddar powder adds color and cheddar identity.
  4. 4.BLEND SMOOTH. Blend until completely smooth, stopping once to scrape the sides if needed.
  5. 5.ADD THE HEAT (ADULT VERSION). Blend in 2 tbsp Smoky Chipotle Crema. Omit for the mild base.
  6. 6.TRANSFER + ADJUST. Move to a jar. For a thinner drizzle, blend in ultra-filtered milk one teaspoon at a time — added milk shifts yield and macros slightly.
  7. 7.SERVE OR WARM GENTLY. Use at room temperature, or warm in short 15-second microwave intervals stirring between each. Do not boil — high heat breaks the emulsion.

Keys to success

  • Fat-free ULTRA-FILTERED milk, not regular skim. The extra protein in ultra-filtered milk stacks the sauce's macro without changing texture.
  • Blend until completely smooth. A few pockets of cottage cheese curd left un-blended will read as grainy on the plate.

If something fails

Grainy texture: Didn't blend long enough. Return to the blender for another 20-30 seconds. Small blenders occasionally need a scrape-down at the halfway point.

Too thick to pour: Add fat-free ultra-filtered milk one teaspoon at a time and re-blend. Do not use water.

Split or oily after warming: Warmed too fast. Reheat in 15-second intervals stirring between each — do not boil. A splash of milk and a whisk usually re-emulsifies.

Not cheesy enough: Cheddar powders vary by brand. Add another 1/2 tsp cheddar powder + 1/2 tsp nutritional yeast and re-blend. Some sharper cheddar powders punch harder than others.

Too spicy for a kid: Blend the base without the Smoky Chipotle Crema; portion the young-kid share first, then blend the crema into the remaining half for the adult version.

Storage and reheating

Store: Tightly covered container in the fridge, up to 4 days.

Reheat: Warm gently in 15-second microwave intervals, stirring between each. Do not boil — the cottage cheese emulsion splits above simmer.

Lasts: 4 days fridge. Add a teaspoon of milk and re-whisk if the sauce thickens between uses.

Flavor target

First taste: smooth cheddar. Mid: cottage cheese body with a chipotle warmth (with the crema) or a clean cheese-forward finish (without). Finish: pourable, holds on a spoon. Ecosystem sauce — batch once, use across the week.

Brands I use

Fairlife
Fat-Free Ultra-Filtered Milk
The extra protein in ultra-filtered milk keeps the sauce macro-friendly without changing texture. Fairlife is the standard; any fat-free ultra-filtered milk works.
The Split Plate
Smoky Chipotle Crema (cookbook cross-link)
The heat carrier for the adult version. Batch this once (12 servings, 5-7 day fridge life) and it drops into this sauce, wings, tacos, bowls, and steak — ecosystem sauce.
The Split Plate
Beef & Potato Slop Bowl (cross-link)
The recipe this sauce was built for. The Slop Bowl uses 2 of the 4 servings; the other 2 hold in the fridge for pasta or vegetables the rest of the week.
Bragg
Nutritional Yeast
Umami + savory backbone. Any nutritional yeast works — Bragg is common and consistent. Recalculate macros if the sub is significantly different.
